meta.title: Web Development Services | Fast, SEO-ready business websites | {name}
meta.description: Custom web development for business websites, landing pages and web apps: multilingual architecture, technical SEO, strong Core Web Vitals and predictable delivery.

webDevelopment.h1: Web Development Services for Fast, SEO-Ready Business Websites
webDevelopment.lead: We design and build websites and web applications that load fast, rank well and turn visitors into enquiries — not just pages that look good in a portfolio.
webDevelopment.intro: We work with service companies, B2B teams and product startups that need predictable delivery, clear ownership of the codebase and a site that keeps earning traffic after launch.

offer.title: What we build
items: Corporate and service websites with a multilingual URL structure and technical SEO built in from the first commit.
Landing pages for paid and organic campaigns, designed around one conversion goal and measured end to end.
Web applications and client portals with a clean architecture that a team can extend without a rewrite.
Rebuilds and migrations of legacy sites that preserve URLs, redirects and the rankings already earned.
Integrations with CRM, payments, booking, analytics and marketing tools so the site feeds your systems directly.

audience.title: Who this is for
items: Businesses whose current site brings traffic but almost no qualified enquiries.
Companies expanding into a second or third language market and needing the URL structure done properly.
Teams stuck on a slow template site that no longer supports their pricing or service range.

steps.title: Discovery and search intent
steps.text: We map the services you sell to the queries people actually type, then decide what deserves its own page. This is where most sites are won or lost.

steps.title: Structure and design
steps.text: Page architecture, internal linking and interface design come together, so every template has a job and a measurable conversion path.

steps.title: Build and integrations
steps.text: Development with server-side rendering, clean metadata, structured data and the third-party systems your operation depends on.

steps.title: Launch and iteration
steps.text: Redirect mapping, indexing checks, analytics validation, then a monthly loop of improvements based on Search Console and real user behaviour.

outcomes.title: What you get
outcomes.text: The goal is not a launch date. It is a site that is fully indexed, fast on mobile, and traceable from a search query to a signed contract.
items: A page for every service you actually sell, each one able to rank on its own.
Core Web Vitals in the green on mobile, where most of your traffic already is.
Analytics and lead tracking wired up, so you can see which pages produce enquiries.
Full ownership of the code and the ability to move hosting whenever you choose.

stack.title: Technology
stack.text: We build on Next.js and React with TypeScript, server-side rendering and a headless CMS when the team needs to edit content. Hosting is typically Vercel with a global CDN, so the same site is fast in Milan, Kyiv and New York.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A focused business site is usually 3 to 6 weeks. A larger platform with integrations runs 8 to 12. The variable is rarely the code — it is content readiness and how fast decisions get approved.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A multi-page business site typically starts around 2 500 EUR, a multilingual site with integrations around 6 000 EUR. We give a fixed quote after discovery, not a range that shifts mid-project.
Yes, and we do it properly: a separate URL per language, correct hreflang and canonical tags, and translated slugs rather than one language bolted onto another's structure.

items.q: Can you improve our existing site instead of rebuilding it?
items.a: Often yes. We run a technical audit first and recommend targeted fixes when the foundation is sound — a rebuild only when it would cost less than maintaining what you have.

items.q: What happens to our rankings when we migrate?
items.a: We map every old URL to a new one with permanent redirects, keep the canonical and hreflang set intact, and monitor indexing for weeks after launch. Done this way a migration protects rankings instead of resetting them.
You do. The repository is yours from day one, and we hand over the deployment setup so you are never locked to us.
